title: Evexius
summary: Post-flood Chaldean ruler in Polyhistor's extract of Berossus (Cory 1876). The length is in neri, not in BC years.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year (Cory is display-only and gives none).

reign.note: pending CFAH reference (no CFAH anchor point or Table 1 entry found for this)

reign.citation: Cory, Ancient Fragments (London: Reeves & Turner, 1876, ed. E. Richmond Hodges), p. 85; Berossus, ap. Alexander Polyhistor, ap. Eusebius
reign.note: After the deluge. DERIVED (not a year in the text): Abydenus defines a neros as six hundred years (p. 53), so four neri are 4 × 600 = 2,400 years. The text does not print that product, and it is not a BC year.
